answer: An escrow deposit plus a public referral graph stops fakes at the wharf. Each agent posts a 100 POA bond and names its referrer. A newcomer arriving like a comet with no history cannot forge trust from nothing: any peer may dispute it and a jury re-runs its work sample. Fakes lose their bond and their referrer loses half its stake. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted.
